title: Feature-Based Prediction of Trajectories for Socially Compliant Navigation
method_family: maximum entropy IRL (continuous); spline trajectory optimization (RPROP); topological variants (homotopy classes); joint human-robot trajectory prediction
state_repr: cubic spline control points of all agents' joint trajectories
reward_design: cost theta^T f with features: travel time, squared acceleration, squared velocity, inverse-squared-distance weighted by speed, (optional) passing side
social_reward: Yes (learned weights reproducing human cooperative avoidance)
prediction_model: Yes (joint trajectory distribution over homotopy classes)

title: Socially Compliant Mobile Robot Navigation via Inverse Reinforcement Learning
method_family: maximum entropy IRL; Hybrid (Hamiltonian) Monte Carlo; homotopy classes via Voronoi graph; spline trajectory optimization (RPROP); shared autonomy
type: IRL (maximum entropy) with mixture over homotopy classes
state_repr: composite spline trajectories of all agents
human_repr: joint trajectories; group membership feature when available
reward_design: theta^T f with physical features (time, acceleration, velocity, distance to agents, distance to obstacles) and theta_hom^T f_hom (passing side, group crossing, ML cost)
prediction_model: Yes (joint mixture distribution; goal inference via Bayes)

title: Learning Socially Normative Robot Navigation Behaviors with Bayesian Inverse Reinforcement Learning
method_family: inverse reinforcement learning (Bayesian, trajectory-based TBIRL); controller graph (SMDP); costmap-based planning (A* + elastic band)
state_repr: controller-graph macro states (continuous, POSQ local controllers)
human_repr: distance to persons, obstacles and social-relation segments; relative heading of persons
reward_design: linear in 6 features (distances to persons/obstacles/relations, relative heading, heading deviation, distance to goal)
social_reward: Yes (learned from demonstrations of polite/sociable/rude etc.)
group_modeling: Yes (pair-wise relations; group tracker grouping probability > 0.5)
generalization: Same features learn multiple behaviours; varied starts/goals

title: Decentralized Non-communicating Multiagent Collision Avoidance with Deep Reinforcement Learning
method_family: DRL (deep V-learning); imitation initialization from ORCA; one-step lookahead
state_repr: agent-centric 15-d joint state (distance to goal, velocities, relative position, radii, heading)
human_repr: other agents as discs with observable position/velocity/radius
reward_design: +1 goal; -0.25 collision; -0.1 - d_min/2 if d_min < 0.2 m; cooperation penalty 0.1 when own extra time small and other's large
social_reward: Partial (cooperation penalty discourages aggressive behaviour; no explicit social norms)
interpretability: Low (value network) but one-step lookahead visualizable
generalization: Two-agent network extended to n agents via min over neighbors (Eq.11)

title: Socially Aware Motion Planning with Deep Reinforcement Learning
method_family: DRL (deep V-learning); reward shaping for social norms; symmetric network with weight sharing + max-pooling
state_repr: agent-centric own state + n-1 neighbours (with virtual-agent padding flag)
human_repr: discs with observable states; comfort buffer added to radius on robot
reward_design: R = R_col (CADRL) + R_norm: penalty q_n when another agent is in passing/overtaking/crossing penalty regions (Eq.9-12)
social_reward: Yes (explicit norm-violation penalties for right- or left-handed rules)
training_env: 2D simulation, self-play, mirrored trajectories, separate bad-experience set
generalization: Four-agent network generalizes to fewer agents via virtual agents

title: Socially Compliant Navigation through Raw Depth Inputs with Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning
method_family: behaviour cloning; GAIL (WGAN + TRPO); multi-task learning (social-force prediction); asynchronous multi-scenario training
human_repr: implicit (pixels); social force as auxiliary label
reward_design: discriminator score as cost + augmented collision penalty
group_modeling: Partial (group passing scenarios in data; no explicit group model)
training_env: Gazebo social-force simulation, 6 scenarios sampled asynchronously
generalization: Six scripted scenarios; real office demo

title: Crowd-Robot Interaction: Crowd-aware Robot Navigation with Attention-based Deep Reinforcement Learning
method_family: DRL (deep V-learning); imitation warm start (ORCA demos); self-attention pooling; local occupancy maps for human-human interaction
type: DRL (deep V-learning) with IL warm start
state_repr: robot-centric joint state; per-human pairwise embeddings; attention-weighted crowd vector
human_repr: position/velocity/radius plus local maps of neighbours (human-human interaction)
reward_design: +1 goal; -0.25 collision; -0.1 + d/2 when separation d < 0.2 m (removed in invisible setting)
prediction_model: Environment-queried next state during training; trajectory predictor suggested for deployment
group_modeling: No (implicit human-human interaction via local maps)
training_env: CrowdNav circle crossing with ORCA humans
generalization: Arbitrary number of humans via attention pooling

title: Arena-Rosnav: Towards Deployment of Deep-Reinforcement-Learning-Based Obstacle Avoidance into Conventional Autonomous Navigation Systems
method_family: DRL (A3C, GRU memory); hierarchical planning (A* + intermediate waypoint generator + DRL local planner); curriculum learning
reward_design: success +15, collision -10, danger -0.15 within safe distance, progress (w_p 0.25 / w_n 0.4), standstill -0.01
training_env: 2D randomized maps with random static and dynamic obstacles; curriculum
generalization: Tested on 2 maps and 3 obstacle velocities

title: Group Estimation for Social Robot Navigation in Crowded Environments
method_family: DRL (PPO); unsupervised clustering (HDBSCAN); proxemic personal-space model; group-space convex hull; reward shaping
state_repr: 3 stacked lidar scans + local goal + robot velocity (DRL-Long architecture)
human_repr: estimated group spaces from clustering observed human states
reward_design: R = R_g + R_c + R_w + R_grp; R_grp = lambda1 * sum_j min(0, d_grp_j - d_safe), lambda1 = 0.1, d_safe = 2.0 m
group_modeling: Yes (HDBSCAN on position + velocity; convex hull of asymmetric Gaussian spaces)
training_env: Stage ROS crowd simulation, 10,000 episodes per scenario

title: NaviSTAR: Socially Aware Robot Navigation with Hybrid Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer and Preference Learning
method_family: DRL (SAC off-policy); GNN (Chebyshev GCN); Transformer (spatio-temporal, multi-modal cross-attention); preference learning (human feedback reward model, FAPL)
state_repr: Joint state of robot and observable humans (position, velocity, radius) over T timesteps as spatio-temporal graph
human_repr: Agent nodes with observable state; Gaussian-kernel adjacency
reward_design: Learned reward network r_alpha from human preferences over trajectory segments (FAPL)
social_reward: Implicit via human preference labels (5,000 from >10 supervisors)
prediction_model: Implicit (temporal transformer); no explicit trajectory forecast
training_env: 2D gym crowd simulator with ORCA humans
social_metrics: Social score (with 0.45 m uncomfortable distance), comfort/naturalness index

title: Rethinking Social Robot Navigation: Leveraging the Best of Two Worlds
method_family: geometric planning (move_base/DWA); behaviour cloning; learned gating classifier; hybrid switching with hysteresis
reward_design: NA (supervised); classifier labels from Hausdorff distance d <= epsilon
interpretability: Medium (switching between explainable geometric planner and BC)
generalization: Tested OOD lab set and two robots/campuses
social_metrics: Hausdorff alignment to demonstrations; Likert ratings
